title: EchoTime DTW similarity
intro_en: The native DTW component runs constrained alignments on both standardized levels and standardized first differences. Each local cost is an absolute gap; the accumulated path cost is divided by the sum of sequence lengths. Two different exponential scales convert those costs into scores, whose geometric mean is the reported component. The animation reconstructs both actual dynamic programs.
intro_zh: 原生 DTW 分项对标准化水平值和标准化一阶差分分别执行有约束对齐。局部代价是绝对差，累计路径代价除以两序列长度之和，再通过不同尺度的指数函数转成分数，最终取几何平均。动图重建这两个实际动态规划。
steps_en: Standardize levels and first differences separately.
Accumulate absolute local costs within the level warping band.
Run the same recurrence on differences with their declared band.
Normalize costs by n+m, use scales 0.45 and 0.35, and combine geometrically.
steps_zh: 分别标准化水平值与一阶差分。
在水平值规整窗口内累加绝对局部代价。
对差分按其窗口执行同样递推。
按 n+m 归一化，以 0.45 和 0.35 指数映射后取几何平均。
caveats_en: This native score differs from square-root-of-squared-cost DTW distances in other libraries.
The band, resampling resolution, derivative normalization and scales affect the value.
A high score does not imply causal correspondence or a probability of identity.
caveats_zh: 此原生分数与其他库常用的平方代价开根号 DTW 距离不同。
窗口、重采样分辨率、差分标准化和指数尺度都会影响数值。
高分不表示因果对应或同一性的概率。
